title: Engage an ER collet groove with an eccentric nut cam
instruction: Prepare the supported ER nut and collet for later toolholder installation. Pick up the collet, tilt it to engage its extraction groove at the marked eccentric-cam side, and rock it upright into the supported nut. Release and withdraw the grippers. Do not insert a cutting tool or tighten a holder.
context: Machining tool setup uses a correctly preassembled ER collet/nut before holder installation. The groove engages an eccentric extraction cam; it is not a free-standing pullout clamp. This fixture isolates that unloaded preparation step.
setup: Standard YAM table top z=0.7475 m. Bench-clamped original nut at (0.24,0,0.8055), thread side up, with lower face supports. Eccentric cam opening radius 18.5 mm, centre offset +2.9 mm X, thickness 0.6 mm; nut front/upper bores 38/40.4 mm. ER32 collet starts upright at (0.28,-0.17,0.8055) on its cradle. Collet Drawing4: D1=33, D2=32, D3=29.2 mm, L=40, groove width=3.6, nose length=5.5 mm, bore=8 mm, 8-degree main and 30-degree nose tapers. The rigid collet omits slots/elastic collapse. Nut/cam/clamp/support dimensions, masses and friction are benchmark-authored; no measured nut geometry or exact toolholder interchangeability is claimed. Complete shapes/parameters and classifications are in scene.json/PARAMETERS.md.
scoring: 0.25 for observed correct tilt/hook at the cam side; 0.50 more for upright supported groove alignment within 0.6 mm lateral, 0.3 mm axial and 0.025 rad tilt. Full score needs 2 s stillness at <=8 mm/s and <=0.15 rad/s with robot >=20 mm clear. A correct final pose without observed cam engagement earns zero. Fixture tamper >1 mm/0.025 rad, loss, invalid telemetry or inter-part penetration >0.35 mm latches zero. No unsupported holding force or tightening torque is scored.
run_limit: 2,400 actions at 20 Hz (120 simulated seconds); ideal controller measured separately.
reset_notes: Seed0, zero jitter. Restore anchors and free-collet initial pose, zero velocities, clear scorer engagement/failure/hold and controller state. No consumables, tool or pressure load.
fidelity: Documented ER32 collet profile and manufacturer groove/eccentric-cam procedure; original nut/cam/support geometry and physical parameters. Rigid faceted unslotted collet; no elastic collapse, holder thread operation, tool clamping, torque, runout or cutting loads. Manufacturer cam is not guaranteed to hold collet unsupported, so final state rests on supports. Native/expert/Dream/hardware not run.
scores: Native expert: not run; Dream-1: not run. CPU ideal tracking is not a physical demonstration.
